correctness.rationale: For the exact positive linear two-generation recurrence, exponential substitution gives a quadratic spectral root. An explicit weighted log-cosh identity proves strict convexity in the spatial tilt, giving unique finite minimizers for all allocations in the parameter domain. At nonenhancing survivals an endpoint test and the strict tilt perturbation at equality prove strict superiority of the immediate pathway. Above threshold an interior max exists; the envelope-zero condition fixes a unique tilt, and a monotone fractional-linear slope condition fixes exactly one mixture. A strictly concave auxiliary function proves one universal survival minimum and the bounded growth band. The packaged program successfully checked thousands of representative identities and inequalities but cannot establish the universal proof.

value.rationale: A genuine population-dispersal tradeoff (delayed survival costs versus longer propagation hops) motivates global allocation. The proof establishes a complete parameter-domain optimizer, sharp universal survival threshold, and a nonmonotone growth band with quantitative examples. This structural phase diagram is not merely a Taylor expansion, parameter rename, numerical grid or arbitrary invariant. Its biological interpretation is strictly limited to a deterministic linear lattice model.
